tools.name: search
tools.description:
Search the library. Each hit is one page of a book, with a url that opens exactly that page; cite that url.

Query grammar: words are ANDed; "a phrase" in double quotes; prefix* (at least 3 letters); a NEAR/5 b; -word excludes. Example: "plurality of gods" Melchizedek -Abraham. There is no OR: run o

tools.name: fetch
verify_quote
tools.description:
Check a quotation before you use it. Pass the exact words you intend to put in quotation marks, and the cite (id or url) you intend to attach. Join omitted stretches with "..." as you would in print.

Verdicts: exact and normalized pass (normalized forgives case, punctuation, hyphenation, ligatures

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
